verdict.rationale: Grok Bot runs on a persistent cloud computer and supports scheduled routines and event-triggered starts. Those are adjacent always-on and automation features, not a headless or CI invocation surface. The runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API, CLI, or MCP endpoint and reports the product is driven only through its own desktop and mobile apps, so nothing documented lets a pipeline run it headlessly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
